name: Automation Factory
description: SaaS web app to visually build Ansible playbooks via drag & drop, with live Ansible Galaxy integration (2200+ namespaces, SMART cache service) and standard YAML export.

commands.test: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --cov=app && cd ../frontend && npm test
commands.lint: cd backend && ruff check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
commands.coverage: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing && cd ../frontend && npm run test:coverage
